recognize_zh: 組織中密集浸潤的小淋巴球與大量核偏位、細胞質嗜酸性的漿細胞樣細胞，環繞一個淡粉紅色、細空泡狀、核稀少的結構（可能為神經束或沉積物）排列；以小細胞加漿細胞分化為主，符合硬腦膜邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular dark nuclei
Numerous plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cells arranged concentrically around a central pale pink, finely vacuolated structure with sparse spindle nuclei (possibly a nerve twig or deposited material)
Scattered small thin-walled vessels within the infiltrate
No large transformed cells, necrosis or mitotic activity evident in this field
describe_en: Tissue section shows a dense infiltrate of small lymphoid cells admixed with numerous plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells bearing eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm, arranged concentrically around a central pale, finely vacuolated eosinophilic structure with sparse spindle nuclei. The nature of the central structure (nerve twig versus deposited material such as amyloid) cannot be determined on this H&E image alone. Large transformed cells are not a prominent feature. In the dural setting, the findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation; immunophenotyping (CD20+, CD5-, CD10-, cyclin D1-) and light chain restriction should be demonstrated, and a Congo red stain may be useful.

ddx.vs: It contains EMA/SSTR2A-positive meningothelial whorls and a polytypic lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate without light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: IgG4-related disease or idiopathic hypertrophic pachymeningitis
ddx.vs: These show storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis and polytypic IgG4-rich plasma cells rather than a clonal B-cell population.
Plasmacytoma lacks a significant CD20-positive B-cell component, and LPL typically involves marrow with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL is parenchymal and angiocentric with sheets of large cells, unlike the small-cell dural infiltrate here.
